subject: SIG questionnaire — evidence collector access & KMS proof clarifications
messages:
From: Samuel Clark <sam.clark@mapletrust.com>
To: mateo_alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@mapletrust.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: SIG questionnaire scope & KMS evidence ask

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for taking this on. We started our SIG review and had two quick clarifications before we proceed with the evidence upload:

1) Collector access: our assurance team prefers to point a lightweight collector at your evidence bucket for automated ingestion of artifacts (logs, cert bundles). Are you able to create a scoped read-only S3 presigned URL / temporary credentials for a collector, or would you prefer we pull from a shared Drive?

2) KMS proof: under control A.6 we need rotation proof and key custody documentation for the KMS you use for customer data encryption. A PDF scan of rotation logs and a statement of key custody policy would be ideal.

Can you also confirm expected delivery timeline? We are trying to finalize vendor evaluation by end of next week.

Thanks,
Samuel Clark
Senior Assurance Manager, MapleTrust Financial
sam.clark@mapletrust.com

On Wed, Apr 11, 2028 at 09:18am, Samuel Clark <sam.clark@mapletrust.com> wrote:
> Attaching initial SIG sections we flagged — will send the full questionnaire in HubSpot link soon.

From: mateo_alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samuel Clark <sam.clark@mapletrust.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 11:02:15 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire scope & KMS evidence ask

Samuel — great to meet you. Thanks for the clear asks. High level plan and options:

- Collector access: we can provide a temporary, scoped read-only S3 role that your collector can assume for a 7-day window. Alternate is a Drive folder sync; we prefer the S3 collector for automated ingestion since it preserves object timestamps and metadata.
- KMS proof: attaching a redacted sample of our rotation log (kms_rotation_logs_sample.pdf) and an internal KMS key custody statement. We will not share actual key material — only rotation events, key IDs (redacted), and audit entries.
- Mapping: we prepared a SIG crosswalk that maps required sections to artifact names (maple_sig_crosswalk.xlsx) and an index CSV for quick ingestion (sig-evidence-index.csv).

Proposed timeline:
- Today (Apr 11): I’ll provision the temp S3 role and upload the three artifacts above to a shared bucket + Drive link.
- Apr 12: 30-minute walkthrough with our security engineer to show where artifacts live and how the collector can authenticate.
- Apr 13: final upload of any additional logs requested after walkthrough.

Are you available for a walkthrough on Apr 12 between 10:00–13:00 PT? If so we’ll lock a slot and send meeting invite and the Drive link.

Notes: Karthik and Monica are looped for evidence packaging and to validate redaction prior to upload.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments referenced: maple_sig_crosswalk.xlsx, kms_rotation_logs_sample.pdf, sig-evidence-index.csv

From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: mateo_alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 07:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire scope & KMS evidence ask — packaging notes

Looping in a couple of packaging details for the walkthrough:

- We will include EPOCH timestamps in the CSV index for each artifact (sig-evidence-index.csv) so their collector can correlate ingestion times.
- KMS rotation PDF: redacted key IDs will use stable pseudonyms (key-01, key-02) and we will include rotation timestamps, actor (role), and ticket reference to our internal change log.
- For S3 access we will create an IAM role with a 7-day assume-role policy and an external ID set to MapleTrust HS-51234 to prevent confused deputy.

I’ve started the upload to a staging bucket and will move to the production staging folder after your review.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Compliance Operations — Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwoodinference.com

From: Samuel Clark <sam.clark@mapletrust.com>
To: mateo_alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@mapletrust.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire scope & KMS evidence ask — quick clarifications

Mateo / Monica — this looks good. A couple of follow-ups before the walkthrough:

- For our audit team we need the rotation entries to include the rotation method (automatic rotation vs manual) and the KMS vendor audit id. If you can add a single line in the PDF indicating rotation method per key pseudonym that’s sufficient.
- Procurement asked whether the collector assume-role will be logged in CloudTrail with the external ID present. Can you confirm CloudTrail includes the external-id attribute for assume-role events (we need to tie the activity to our external ID).

We are available for the walkthrough Apr 12 at 11:00 PT. Please send an invite and the meeting link.

Samuel Clark
Senior Assurance Manager, MapleTrust Financial

From: mateo_alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samuel Clark <sam.clark@mapletrust.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Apr 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire scope & KMS evidence ask — artifacts uploaded and walkthrough confirmed

Samuel — thanks, meeting invite sent for Apr 12 11:00 PT (calendar may show yours as Apr 13 depending on timezone but we scheduled in your local availability). Quick status:

- Uploaded artifacts to staging bucket and Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleLink (shared with sam.clark@mapletrust.com and procurement@mapletrust.com).
- Attachments included: maple_sig_crosswalk.xlsx, kms_rotation_logs_sample.pdf (contains rotation method lines as requested), sig-evidence-index.csv, walkthrough-slides.pptx.
- IAM role: created with 7-day assume-role policy, external ID set to HS-51234, and CloudTrail logging enabled. We verified that assume-role events include the external-id attribute in CloudTrail (sample log line included in kms_rotation_logs_sample.pdf).

If anything in the artifacts needs different redaction or additional timestamps, flag it during the walkthrough and we’ll push updated copies. Looking forward to the walkthrough — Karthik will demonstrate the collector auth flow and Monica will show the crosswalk mapping.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
